text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] elevated error-rate and latency on dedicated-apac-2 (5xx rate up, avg p95 latency 5.1s). Health: 2/10 backends failing healthcheck. Severity: high. Paging oncall.
Priya Rao: I'm awake, taking lead. gathering quick context.
Luis Martinez: seeing sustained queue growth on batch service, autoscaler hasn't added new instances for ~6m despite CPU and GPU util high. There was a small config change to scaling cooldown yesterday.
Eve Zhang: support queue shows 7 tickets; two customers reporting sustained 429s and one reporting internal retries causing client side instability (ticket #5498).
Priya Rao: immediate plan: 1) enable burst reserve for pool to add emergency nodes, 2) apply conservative per-project QPS caps for top traffic customers, 3) reduce batch window and disable prefetching feature for this pool.
Oliver Hayes: agree. I'll run pool burst command and bump max-instances.
Oliver Hayes: running:
```
redwoodctl pools patch --pool dedicated-apac-2 --burst-mode on --burst-reserve 3
redwoodctl pools patch --pool dedicated-apac-2 --max-instances 16
```
ops-bot: Action accepted: burst-mode=on, burst-reserve=3, max-instances=16. Rolling change to capacity manager.
Priya Rao: applying short-lived quotas for heavy customers. I'm pushing a rule to console to cap project-level generate endpoint to 75rps for projects tagged "enterprise-high-qps".
Eve Zhang: I'll notify Support to send initial customer advisory: short blurb + expected mitigation window 10-20 minutes. Draft: "We're investigating increased errors and latency in the APAC Dedicated pool. We've activated burst capacity and temporary rate limits; full service expected to normalize shortly. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
Luis Martinez: also toggling autoscaler policy to faster scale-up while we monitor:
```
redwoodctl autoscaler set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --policy fast-aggressive --scale-up 30s --scale-down 120s
```
Priya Rao: also reducing batch window and turning off multi_stream_prefetch (known to increase head-of-line blocking under stress).
```
redwoodctl features set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --feature multi_stream_prefetch=false
redwoodctl config set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --key batch_window_ms --value 50
```
incident-bot: Changes applied. Monitor window 10m.
Priya Rao: dashboards show tail latency decreasing to ~3.4s after 90s, queued requests dropping. 5xx count trending down but still above baseline.
Oliver Hayes: burst nodes are coming up, but a few are failing GPU driver health checks (nvml). I'm SSHing into one for logs.
Oliver Hayes: found a driver mismatch on node img-2025-04-stable. Patching nodes via rolling restart of new image.
Priya Rao: if more nodes fail, fallback is to route traffic to dedicated-eu-1 for affected projects. Can we prepare a routing policy?
Luis Martinez: preparing a routing policy to steer non-low-latency projects to eu pool. will stage a rule with gradual ramp to avoid double-surge.
Eve Zhang: support pushed customer advisory. two customers acknowledged and reduced retries. That helped.
Nora Kim: I'm on standby to take over. Priya, how long you staying?
Priya Rao: I'll stay primary for next 20m, then hand off to Nora. Dan (not in channel) FYI.
Oliver Hayes: patch done, failing nodes now healthy. burst reserve bringing pool to 14 instances. latency p95 ~2.6s, error-rate down to 0.3% (baseline 0.05%).
ops-bot: Feature toggle multi_stream_prefetch disabled for dedicated-apac-2 by Priya Rao.
Luis Martinez: marking mitigation successful for now. Follow-ups: revert burst-mode after stability, investigate autoscaler cooldown regression, add image validation to node boot pipeline.
Priya Rao: rollback steps saved here for Nora:
```
# rollback burst and autoscaler changes
redwoodctl pools patch --pool dedicated-apac-2 --burst-mode off --burst-reserve 0
redwoodctl pools patch --pool dedicated-apac-2 --max-instances 12
redwoodctl autoscaler set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --policy default --scale-up 60s --scale-down 300s
redwoodctl features set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --feature multi_stream_prefetch=true
redwoodctl config set --pool dedicated-apac-2 --key batch_window_ms --value 200
```
Nora Kim: got it. I'll run the rollback only if errors rebound or we get fresh alerts. taking over now. thanks Priya. :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: creating incident doc and assigning postmortem to Luis to include autoscaler tuning + node image CI checks. Ranjit from CS included for customer notes.
Eve Zhang: I'll follow up on tickets and update customers with timeline once postmortem ready.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at ts=2198001410. Reminder: attach logs and exact CLI outputs to the incident tracker.
